ground.source: Arena agents, stylized-procedural-texture-graphs-New.zip (2026-10-03); the first style of each surface is the SetMix default; grass "Painted clumps" added by SetMix

styles.label: Painted clumps
styles.note: SetMix default (2026-10-03): round warped clumps lit from inside, fine blade noise over them, dry olive patches from a low-frequency mask; no grid-aligned noise, so no blocky crosses up close.

styles.label: Star tufts
styles.note: Egg-crate star tufts over a lower back layer. Albedo darkens toward the roots and lightens at the tips, the same from every side; dry yellow-green patches from a low-frequency tint.

styles.label: Tufts + clover + flowers
styles.note: One tuft layer with round clover leaves in patches and sparse white flowers as the tertiary detail.

styles.label: Tall meadow
styles.note: Bigger, spikier tufts (stronger egg-crate pull), dry patches and a sprinkle of yellow flowers.

styles.label: Dense lawn
styles.note: Small dense tufts at 11 and 15 across in a quieter palette, for wide fields.

styles.label: Calm ripples + shells
styles.note: Skewed wind ripples faded in and out, pebbles in drifts and a few pale shells; low value contrast so it rests the eye.

styles.label: Pebble beach
styles.note: Flatter ripples with two sizes of pebbles.

styles.label: Rain-pitted
styles.note: Smooth sand dimpled by two sizes of flat-bottomed rain pits.

styles.label: Ripples + water film
styles.note: Tighter ripples, darker palette, glossy water-film patches: roughness 0.25 in the film, 0.38 elsewhere.

styles.label: Worm casts
styles.note: Smooth wet flat with small holes and little cast mounds, water film in patches.

styles.label: Drainage rivulets
styles.note: Meandering channels cut along the n = 0.5 contour of a noise; water stands in them (roughness 0.25).

styles.label: Chiseled boulders
styles.note: Four big stones a tile with chipped outlines and planar facets, a lower generation of small rocks, and warm dust settled in the low ground.

styles.label: Lichen + moss
styles.note: Chiseled rock coloured by distance to the edge: violet cavities, a worn cream rim, yellow lichen spots on top and moss in the joints.

styles.label: Cracked slabs
styles.note: Three big tipped slabs per tile with a thin warped crack network across them.

styles.label: Fractured boulders
styles.note: Three big plates a tile with strong planar facets, split by meandering contour cracks and pitted; cold worn rims, violet cavities.

styles.label: Cushions
styles.note: Packed cushions with small bumps; yellow-green tint patches.

styles.label: Moss over stones
styles.note: Rounded stones almost buried in moss; grey shows where the moss mask thins.

styles.label: Billow moss
styles.note: Billow noise: puffy clumps with sharp creases, peppered with fine bumps.

styles.label: Clods + pebbles
styles.note: Warped clods, pebbles in clusters, pitted with small holes.

styles.label: Cracked earth
styles.note: Dried earth: curled plates, a finer crack generation and pits.

styles.label: Tilled furrows
styles.note: Wavy furrows from warped stripes, broken into clods, with a scatter of pebbles.

styles.label: Roots + pebbles
styles.note: Raised roots along the crests of ridged noise, crossing soft ground, pebbles between.

styles.label: Crust plates
styles.note: Faceted crust plates floating on glowing lava: the edge field runs yellow in the gap, orange at the lip, dark crust on top; thin cracks glow too. Cracks roughness 0.3, crust 0.55.

styles.label: Ropy pahoehoe
styles.note: Ropes from a double-warped meander, cracked on the crests, glowing in the narrow troughs.

styles.label: Glowing veins
styles.note: Undulating dark crust split by meandering veins on the n = 0.5 contour of a noise, glowing through.

styles.label: Fractured plates
styles.note: Near-black plates (low jitter) with a cold worn rim, fine cracks and gas vesicles.

styles.label: Vesicular boulders
styles.note: Chiseled dark boulders with chipped outlines, riddled with gas holes.

styles.label: Pahoehoe
styles.note: Cooled ropy lava: a directionless labyrinth, pitted.

styles.label: Broad dunes
styles.note: Four skewed dune waves, steep lee and long stoss, very low value contrast.

styles.label: Rippled crests
styles.note: Five dune waves carrying a finer ripple set.

styles.label: Crest lines
styles.note: Ridged noise draws meandering crest lines; a fine ripple set rides over them.

styles.label: Puddles
styles.note: Smeared mounds with flat puddles capped into the height; puddles drop to roughness 0.22.

styles.label: Cracked mud
styles.note: Curled mud plates with dark wet cracks (roughness 0.2) and pits.

styles.label: Churned ruts
styles.note: Billow lumps pressed by two wheel ruts that hold water.

styles.label: Angular scree
styles.note: Separate faceted stones in two generations, chipped, dust between them.

styles.label: Mixed rubble
styles.note: Three sizes: big and small faceted stones plus gravel.

styles.label: Platy shale
styles.note: Small flat plates tipped at different angles, like split shale.

styles.label: Porous blocks
styles.note: Two scales of round holes on big soft facets.

styles.label: Frothy chunks
styles.note: Chiseled chunks riddled with holes at 13 and 27 across.

styles.label: Honeycomb
styles.note: Flat-bottomed bowls (gamma 2.5) meeting in sharp walls, a second size of pits inside.

styles.label: Nubs
styles.note: Rounded nubs (gamma 2 domes) at two sizes with polyp pits; overlay tints shift patches toward violet or peach.

styles.label: Brain coral
styles.note: Directionless labyrinth from a warped egg-crate, pitted with polyps.

styles.label: Spiky coral
styles.note: The same cells as spikes (gamma 0.5) at two sizes.

styles.label: Banded ledges
styles.note: A band sine plus a finer non-harmonic set, bent by two warps, cut by joints.

styles.label: Terraced
styles.note: The strata field summed through four thresholds: stepped ledges with a little slope kept on each tread.

styles.label: Eroded layer-cake
styles.note: Thin sharp layers, pitted and chiseled.

styles.label: Jointed blocks
styles.note: Tall slabs from warped vertical V-joints, broken into blocks by irregular cross-cracks, faceted by the cell roof, pitted; dust in the joints.

styles.label: Chiseled crags
styles.note: Three big chiseled crags per tile, smaller ones between, faceted again at 13 across; dust in the low ground.

styles.label: Stepped ledges
styles.note: Horizontal strata terraced into ledges, faded along their length, cracked across.

styles.label: Ripples + caustics
styles.note: Pale sand ripples seen through cool water with soft caustic ribbons; roughness 0.1-0.2.

styles.label: Pebbles under water
styles.note: Rounded pebbles through cool water with caustic light on top.

styles.label: Sandbars
styles.note: Long skewed sandbars with a fine ripple set and caustics.

styles.label: Aggregate
styles.note: Dense chips with binder, a scatter of larger stones and pale aggregate speckle; matte 0.8-0.92.

styles.label: Patched + cracked
styles.note: Aggregate crossed by a warped crack network, with darker resurfaced patches.

styles.label: Worn lane
styles.note: Two tyre-polished wheel paths: smoother, slightly darker and down to roughness 0.6.

styles.label: Aggregate + puddles
styles.note: Dark wet aggregate with flat puddles; roughness 0.21-0.33.

styles.label: Wet cracks
styles.note: Wet aggregate with water standing in a warped crack network.

styles.label: Glossy tracks
styles.note: Two wheel tracks almost mirror-wet (0.21) on a 0.33 surface.

styles.label: Worn + cracked
styles.note: Painted 8 x 8 checker chipped through to asphalt and cracked; paint is a slightly raised, smoother layer (0.61 vs 0.88).

styles.label: Tyre-marked
styles.note: Checker with dark rubber streaks laid along the racing line; rubber is smoother than paint.

styles.label: Fresh paint
styles.note: Nearly intact paint, only a few chips.

styles.label: Glow chevrons
styles.note: Triangle-wave chevrons in bright teal glossy resin (roughness 0.24-0.36), lightly scuffed.

styles.label: Riveted plate
styles.note: Chevron plate with a rivet grid and rust creeping out of the grooves (rough rust, glossy plate).

styles.label: Hex emitters
styles.note: Low-jitter voronoi pads glowing teal in a dark frame, coloured along the edge field.

styles.label: Worn blocks
styles.note: V-grooved red and white blocks, paint chipped through to concrete.

styles.label: Rumble strip
styles.note: Raised transverse bars on every block, paint worn off in patches.

styles.label: Grimy
styles.note: More wear and dirt packed into the joints.

styles.label: Packed tracks
styles.note: Smooth mottled dirt, pebbles in drifts, cracks only in dry patches, two smoother tyre bands.

styles.label: Rutted
styles.note: Two deep ruts pressed into soft ground, pebbles and pits along them.

styles.label: Puddled ruts
styles.note: Ruts holding water: darker and glossy (0.25) in the ruts, 0.9 on the crown.

styles.label: Planks + knots
styles.note: V-grooved planks, staggered butt joints, grain bent around a few chunky knots.

styles.label: Long split boards
styles.note: Unjointed long boards with short splits along the grain.

styles.label: Weathered + mossy
styles.note: Silver-grey weathered boards with moss growing in the grooves.

styles.label: Chiseled cobbles
styles.note: Matched to the flat-albedo reference: individual stones with irregular outlines and spacing, a flat hue per stone patch, a worn cream rim all round, violet cavities, lichen dots and moss in the joints. No light in the colour; the facet planes come from the height.

styles.label: River cobbles
styles.note: Rounded flat-topped stones in variable joints, per-patch hue, moss between.

styles.label: Setts (regular)
styles.note: Rectangular setts in staggered courses with domed tops and chipped corners; dust in the joints.

styles.label: Flagstones
styles.note: Big flat slate slabs, tipped, cracked in places, a hue shift per patch.

styles.label: Soft dust
styles.note: Pale soft dirt, pebbles in clusters, grit speckle and lighter drift patches.

styles.label: Wind-swept
styles.note: Faint drift ripples with pebbles showing through.

styles.label: Gravel
styles.note: Fine angular gravel with larger pebbles in drifts.

styles.label: Hex tops
styles.note: Near-regular column tops at different heights, chiseled at 13 across, cracked at 11; cold worn rims.

styles.label: Stepped + rubble
styles.note: Columns with big height steps, rubble and dust in the joints.

styles.label: Mossy joints
styles.note: Column tops with lichen spots and moss filling the joints.
